_readme.what: Per-locale App Store listing copy for Ball IQ 1.6.0. Source of truth for BOTH App Store Connect and Play Store — write it here, then apply.
_readme.why_a_file: Typing 14 locales straight into a console leaves no diff, no review and nothing reusable. This file is the artefact; the console is just where it lands.
_readme.screenshots: NOT needed per locale. App Store Connect inherits them from the primary (English U.K.) and shows 'Using English (U.K.) 6.5" Display'. Only the text fields below are per-locale.
hard_rules: NAME + SUBTITLE + KEYWORDS must share NO word. Apple indexes only those three fields and builds phrases ACROSS them, so a repeat is counted once and wasted. Verified per locale by scripts/check-localisations.mjs.
NO COUNTS anywhere (question totals, club totals, mode totals). Binding project rule — it has come back disguised three times.
NO FIFA / World Cup wording. Guideline 5.2.1 rejected 1.3.3 for exactly that.

Keywords must name features that EXIST (Guideline 2.3.7). Every league/competition term below is backed by shipped content — Super Lig, Brasileirao, Libertadores, Bundesliga, Serie A and Premier League all have live quiz packs or list pages.

NO club or competition trademarks in the KEYWORDS field. Club names in the description are descriptive use and fine; as keywords they invite the same trademark trouble the FIFA rejection already cost us.
_readme.known_risk: The app UI is ENGLISH ONLY — there is no i18n in src/ and no CFBundleLocalizations in Info.plist. Non-English listings therefore send users to an English app. Alex was shown this and chose full coverage anyway (2026-08-15). Watch the non-English storefronts for 'not in my language' reviews and for retention dropping below the English baseline; if it shows, the cheapest fix is app i18n, not pulling the listings.
_readme.confidence: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian copy is written to native register. Turkish, Indonesian and especially ARABIC should get a native read before they are treated as final — flagged rather than silently shipped.

⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.rule: EVERY localisation needs an app name that is unique across the whole App Store — including against the OTHER localisations of this same app. A new locale pre-fills with the primary's name, and saving it as-is fails with 'the app name you entered is already being used'.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.how_it_shows: The error names ONE locale at a time even when several are wrong, so fixing the named locale just surfaces the next. It also blocks the ENTIRE App Information save — en-AU looked saved while it was not, because en-CA was invalid. Save staying ENABLED is the tell; the button never disables until the whole page validates.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.status: FULLY RESOLVED. All 15 locales complete. Only FOUR names were genuinely taken and needed rewriting: en-CA (-> Soccer Puzzles), en-AU (-> Football Puzzles), es-MX (-> Quiz Futbolero), it (-> Quiz sul Calcio).
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.next_step: Search the App Store for each candidate name BEFORE typing it into ASC. Then apply ONE locale, save, confirm Save goes disabled, and only then move to the next.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.note_on_the_hyphen: Alex first said drop the "-" everywhere, then reconsidered on seeing it: KEEP IT. It costs 2 of 30 characters we are not using (names run 19-26) and Apple ignores punctuation when indexing, so it is free — and it separates the brand from the descriptor, which reads better. The hyphen-less names now live in es-ES/pt-BR/de exist only because those were the strings Apple would accept; re-add the hyphen there if a hyphenated variant turns out to be free.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.⚠️ THE VERIFICATION TRAP: The Save button DISAPPEARS while the request is in flight, so a check that runs a few seconds after clicking reads a mid-save state and reports success for a save that is about to fail. This produced a false "es-MX saved" that the next page-save exposed. THE ONLY TRUSTWORTHY CHECK IS: reload the page, switch to the locale, read the value back. Nothing else counts.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.⚠️ I MISDIAGNOSED THIS ONCE: I reported tr, fr, it and pt-PT as "name already taken" on the strength of a failed save, without ever reading an error that named them. Three of the four then saved on the first retry when applied individually. A failed save is not evidence of WHY it failed — read the banner, and note the banner lags one interaction behind.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.remaining_work: NONE for iOS 1.6.0. The same copy is the source for the Play Store listing when that is next touched.
⚠️ THE BLOCKER — APP NAME UNIQUENESS.⚠️ TWO DIFFERENT PAGES, TWO DIFFERENT RU: APP INFORMATION enforces app-name uniqueness, so one invalid locale silently blocks the whole page save and locales MUST be applied one at a time with a reload to verify. The VERSION page has no uniqueness constraint, so several locales can be filled in a single pass safely. Conflating the two is what made this look far worse than it was.

_readme.⚠️ NON-ENGLISH LOCALES SHOULD NOT HIT TH: Their names are genuinely different strings (Quiz de Fútbol, Quiz de Futebol, Futbol Quiz, Fußball Quiz…), so the uniqueness collision that blocked en-CA/en-AU is specific to the English variants, where the name is nearly identical to the primary. Apply those next — they are also the ones with real supporting data.

en-US.name: Ball IQ - Soccer Quiz
en-US.subtitle: Daily Puzzles & Club Trivia
en-US.promo: New: Mystery Player and Transfer Trail. Four daily puzzles, one soccer brain. Guess the secret player, name him from his career, and keep the streak alive.
en-US.description:
Ball IQ — Soccer Quiz

The soccer quiz for people who actually watch soccer.

Every question here is written and fact-checked by football fans — never scraped, never auto-generated. From the Premier League to the Eredivisie, from the Lisbon Lions to last night, Ball IQ has the depth real supporters demand and the details the other quiz apps get wrong.

Four daily puzzles, a quiz for your own club, and one place to find out how much you really know.

FOOTLE — THE DAILY WORD PUZZLE
One player's surname, six guesses, letter-by-letter color feedback — green for the right letter in the right place, amber for the right letter in the wrong place. Everyone in the world gets the same player each day, and there's a streak to protect.

TRANSFER TRAIL — NAME HIM FROM HIS CAREER
A player's career appears one club at a time — youth side, breakthrough move, the big transfer — and you name him before the trail runs out. The fewer clubs you need, the more points you score.

MYSTERY PLAYER — EVERY GUESS GETS YOU CLOSER
Name any player and he comes back ranked against the secret player — shared clubs, era, position, nationality and age all count. Rank 1 is the answer and nothing else is.

A QUIZ FOR YOUR CLUB
Not a generic soccer round — a dedicated, fact-checked quiz for the club you actually support: Arsenal, Liverpool, Man United, Man City, Chelsea, Tottenham, Barcelona, Real Madrid, Juventus, Inter, AC Milan, Bayern, Dortmund, PSG, Ajax, Celtic and many more.

GAME MODES
- Daily 7 — a fresh quiz every day. Share your score, build a streak.
- Classic — pick your difficulty and beat your best.
- Survival — keep going until you get one wrong.
- Hot Streak — 60 seconds, maximum questions.
- Online Multiplayer — take on friends in real time over a shared room code.
- Pass-and-Play — local multiplayer on a single device.
- Ball IQ Test — calibrated questions produce a score you can compare with anyone.

BUILT DIFFERENTLY
- Written by hand and checked against the record books — not AI-generated noise
- Most answers come with a short explanation, so the quiz teaches as it tests
- Works offline — your scores sync when you're back online
- No ads, no third-party ad trackers, and your data is never sold

Built solo from Norway by someone who loves the game and got tired of quiz apps that treat supporters like they know nothing.

Spotted something wrong? Email hello@balliq.app. Every message goes straight to the developer.

es-ES.description:
Ball IQ — Quiz de Fútbol

El quiz de fútbol para quien ve fútbol de verdad.

Cada pregunta está escrita y verificada por aficionados — nunca copiada, nunca generada automáticamente. De la Premier a la Eredivisie, Ball IQ tiene la profundidad que exige un aficionado real y los detalles que otras apps se inventan.

Cuatro retos diarios, un quiz de tu propio club y un sitio donde descubrir cuánto sabes realmente.

FOOTLE — EL RETO DIARIO DE PALABRAS
El apellido de un futbolista, seis intentos y pistas de color letra a letra: verde si la letra está en su sitio, ámbar si está en la palabra pero en otra posición. Todo el mundo recibe el mismo jugador cada día.

RUTA DE FICHAJES — RECONÓCELO POR SU CARRERA
La carrera de un futbolista aparece club a club: la cantera, el salto, el gran traspaso. Cuantos menos clubes necesites, más puntos consigues.

JUGADOR MISTERIOSO — CADA INTENTO TE ACERCA
Nombra a cualquier futbolista y volverá clasificado frente al jugador secreto: clubes en común, época, posición, nacionalidad y edad cuentan. El puesto 1 es la respuesta y no hay otra.

UN QUIZ PARA TU CLUB
Nada de preguntas genéricas: un quiz propio y verificado del club al que animas de verdad — Real Madrid, Barcelona, Atlético, Liverpool, Arsenal, Manchester United, Juventus, Milan, Bayern, PSG, River, Boca y muchos más.

MODOS DE JUEGO
- Daily 7 — un reto nuevo cada día. Comparte tu resultado y crea una racha.
- Clásico — elige la dificultad y supera tu marca.
- Supervivencia — un fallo y se acabó.
- Hot Streak — sesenta segundos, las máximas preguntas posibles.
- Multijugador online — reta a tus amigos en tiempo real con un código de sala.
- Pasa y juega — multijugador local en un solo dispositivo.

HECHO DE OTRA MANERA
- Escrito a mano y contrastado con los libros de récords
- La mayoría de respuestas incluyen una explicación breve
- Funciona sin conexión; tus resultados se sincronizan al volver
- Sin anuncios, sin rastreadores publicitarios y tus datos nunca se venden

Hecho en solitario desde Noruega por alguien que ama este deporte.

tr.description:
Ball IQ — Futbol Quiz

Gerçekten futbol izleyenler için hazırlanmış bir futbol testi.

Buradaki her soru futbolseverler tarafından yazılır ve doğrulanır — hiçbiri kopyalanmaz, hiçbiri otomatik üretilmez. Süper Lig'den Premier Lig'e, Eredivisie'den Şampiyonlar Ligi'ne kadar Ball IQ gerçek taraftarın beklediği derinliğe sahiptir.

Her gün dört bulmaca, kendi kulübün için ayrı bir test ve gerçekte ne kadar bildiğini öğrenebileceğin tek yer.

FOOTLE — GÜNLÜK KELİME BULMACASI
Bir futbolcunun soyadı, altı tahmin hakkı ve harf harf renk ipuçları: doğru yerdeki doğru harf yeşil, yanlış yerdeki doğru harf turuncu. Dünyadaki herkes aynı gün aynı oyuncuyu alır.

TRANSFER ROTASI — KARİYERİNDEN TANI
Bir futbolcunun kariyeri kulüp kulüp açılır: altyapı, çıkış yaptığı takım, büyük transfer. Ne kadar az kulübe ihtiyaç duyarsan o kadar çok puan alırsın.

GİZEMLİ OYUNCU — HER TAHMİN SENİ YAKLAŞTIRIR
Aklına gelen herhangi bir futbolcuyu yaz; gizli oyuncuya göre sıralanmış olarak geri gelsin. Ortak kulüpler, dönem, mevki, uyruk ve yaş hesaba katılır. Bir numara cevaptır, başka hiçbir şey değil.

KULÜBÜNE ÖZEL TEST
Genel bir futbol turu değil: gerçekten tuttuğun kulüp için hazırlanmış, doğrulanmış bir test — Galatasaray, Fenerbahçe, Trabzonspor, Real Madrid, Barcelona, Liverpool, Manchester United, Bayern, PSG ve çok daha fazlası.

OYUN MODLARI
- Daily 7 — her gün yeni bir test. Skorunu paylaş, serini büyüt.
- Klasik — zorluğu seç ve rekorunu geç.
- Hayatta Kalma — bir yanlış ve oyun biter.
- Hot Streak — altmış saniye, olabildiğince çok soru.
- Çevrimiçi çok oyunculu — oda koduyla arkadaşlarına canlı meydan oku.
- Sırayla oyna — tek cihazda yerel çok oyunculu.

FARKLI BİR YAKLAŞIM
- Elle yazıldı ve rekor kitaplarıyla karşılaştırıldı
- Cevapların çoğunda kısa bir açıklama var
- Çevrimdışı çalışır; bağlandığında skorların eşitlenir
- Reklam yok, üçüncü taraf reklam takipçisi yok ve verilerin asla satılmaz

Norveç'te futbolu seven biri tarafından tek başına yapıldı.

Bir hata mı gördün? hello@balliq.app adresine yaz. Her mesaj doğrudan geliştiriciye ulaşır.

Ball IQ — Quiz de Foot

Le quiz de foot pour ceux qui regardent vraiment le foot.

FOOTLE — LE DÉFI DE MOTS QUOTIDIEN
Le nom d'un joueur, six essais et des indices lettre par lettre : vert pour la bonne lettre au bon endroit, orange pour la bonne lettre au mauvais endroit. Tout le monde reçoit le même joueur chaque jour.

PARCOURS TRANSFERTS — RECONNAIS-LE À SA CARRIÈRE
La carrière d'un joueur se dévoile club après club : la formation, le premier vrai club, le grand transfert. Moins tu as besoin de clubs, plus tu marques.

JOUEUR MYSTÈRE — CHAQUE ESSAI TE RAPPROCHE
Cite n'importe quel joueur : il revient classé face au joueur secret. Clubs communs, époque, poste, nationalité et âge comptent tous. La première place est la réponse, et rien d'autre.

UN QUIZ POUR TON CLUB
Pas une manche générique : un quiz dédié et vérifié pour le club que tu soutiens vraiment — PSG, Marseille, Lyon, Monaco, Real Madrid, Barcelone, Liverpool, Manchester United, Juventus, Milan, Bayern, Ajax et bien d'autres.

- Daily 7 — un défi inédit chaque jour. Partage ton score et construis ta série.

- Survie — une erreur et c'est fini.
- Hot Streak — soixante secondes, un maximum de questions.

de.name: Ball IQ Fußball Quiz
de.subtitle: Spieler raten, täglich neu
de.promo: Neu: Rätselspieler und Transferweg. Vier tägliche Rätsel. Errate den geheimen Spieler, erkenne ihn an seiner Karriere und halte deine Serie.
de.description:
Ball IQ — Fußball Quiz

Das Fußballquiz für alle, die wirklich Fußball schauen.

Jede Frage wird von Fans geschrieben und geprüft — nie abgeschrieben, nie automatisch erzeugt. Von der Bundesliga bis zur Premier League, von der Eredivisie bis zur Champions League hat Ball IQ die Tiefe, die echte Anhänger erwarten.

Vier tägliche Rätsel, ein Quiz für deinen eigenen Verein und ein Ort, an dem du herausfindest, wie viel du wirklich weißt.

FOOTLE — DAS TÄGLICHE WORTRÄTSEL
Der Nachname eines Spielers, sechs Versuche und Farbhinweise Buchstabe für Buchstabe: grün für den richtigen Buchstaben an der richtigen Stelle, orange für den richtigen Buchstaben an der falschen Stelle. Alle bekommen jeden Tag denselben Spieler.

TRANSFERWEG — ERKENNE IHN AN SEINER KARRIERE
Die Karriere eines Spielers erscheint Verein für Verein: die Jugend, der Durchbruch, der große Wechsel. Je weniger Vereine du brauchst, desto mehr Punkte bekommst du.

RÄTSELSPIELER — JEDER TIPP BRINGT DICH NÄHER
Nenne einen beliebigen Spieler, und er kommt im Vergleich zum geheimen Spieler eingeordnet zurück. Gemeinsame Vereine, Ära, Position, Nationalität und Alter zählen alle. Platz eins ist die Antwort und sonst nichts.

EIN QUIZ FÜR DEINEN VEREIN
Keine allgemeine Fußballrunde, sondern ein eigenes, geprüftes Quiz für den Verein, den du wirklich unterstützt — Bayern, Dortmund, Leverkusen, Real Madrid, Barcelona, Liverpool, Manchester United, Juventus, Milan, PSG, Ajax und viele mehr.

SPIELMODI
- Daily 7 — jeden Tag ein neues Rätsel. Teile dein Ergebnis und baue eine Serie auf.
- Klassisch — wähle die Schwierigkeit und schlage deinen Rekord.
- Überleben — ein Fehler und es ist vorbei.
- Hot Streak — sechzig Sekunden, so viele Fragen wie möglich.
- Online-Mehrspieler — fordere Freunde in Echtzeit über einen Raumcode heraus.
- Reihum spielen — lokaler Mehrspielermodus auf einem Gerät.

ANDERS GEMACHT
- Von Hand geschrieben und mit den Rekordbüchern abgeglichen
- Die meisten Antworten kommen mit einer kurzen Erklärung
- Funktioniert offline; deine Ergebnisse werden synchronisiert, sobald du wieder online bist
- Keine Werbung, keine Werbetracker von Dritten, und deine Daten werden nie verkauft

Allein aus Norwegen entwickelt, von jemandem, der diesen Sport liebt.

Einen Fehler entdeckt? Schreib an hello@balliq.app. Jede Nachricht geht direkt an den Entwickler.
de.whatsNew:
Rätselspieler und Transferweg gehören jetzt zu deinen vier täglichen Rätseln.

• Tippe in beiden Spielen einfach einen Namen an und wähle ihn aus einer sortierten Liste. Du musst einen Spieler nicht mehr fehlerfrei schreiben, um zu raten.
• Eine deutlich bessere Bewertung im Rätselspieler. Die Ära zählt jetzt mit, sodass ein Torwart aus derselben Generation so nah erscheint, wie er sollte.
• Tausende Spieler waren mit einem Verein gelistet, den sie längst verlassen hatten. Ihre aktuellen Vereine stimmen jetzt.
• Ein Fehler wurde behoben, durch den die App ohne Verbindung im Ladebildschirm hängen bleiben konnte.

it.name: Ball IQ - Quiz sul Calcio
it.subtitle: Indovina il giocatore
it.promo: Novità: Giocatore Misterioso e Percorso Trasferimenti. Quattro sfide al giorno. Indovina il calciatore segreto e mantieni la tua striscia.
it.description:
Ball IQ — Quiz di Calcio

Il quiz di calcio per chi il calcio lo guarda davvero.

Ogni domanda è scritta e verificata da tifosi — mai copiata, mai generata automaticamente. Dalla Serie A alla Premier League, dall'Eredivisie alla Champions, Ball IQ ha la profondità che un tifoso vero pretende.

Quattro sfide al giorno, un quiz per la tua squadra e un posto dove scoprire quanto sai davvero.

FOOTLE — LA SFIDA QUOTIDIANA DI PAROLE
Il cognome di un calciatore, sei tentativi e indizi colorati lettera per lettera: verde per la lettera giusta al posto giusto, arancione per la lettera giusta al posto sbagliato. Tutti ricevono lo stesso giocatore ogni giorno.

PERCORSO TRASFERIMENTI — RICONOSCILO DALLA CARRIERA
La carriera di un calciatore compare squadra dopo squadra: il settore giovanile, il salto, il grande trasferimento. Meno squadre ti servono, più punti fai.

GIOCATORE MISTERIOSO — OGNI TENTATIVO TI AVVICINA
Nomina un calciatore qualsiasi e tornerà classificato rispetto al giocatore segreto: squadre in comune, epoca, ruolo, nazionalità ed età contano tutte. Il primo posto è la risposta, e nient'altro.

UN QUIZ PER LA TUA SQUADRA
Non un giro generico: un quiz dedicato e verificato per la squadra che tifi davvero — Juventus, Inter, Milan, Napoli, Roma, Real Madrid, Barcellona, Liverpool, Manchester United, Bayern, PSG, Ajax e molte altre.

MODALITÀ DI GIOCO
- Daily 7 — una sfida nuova ogni giorno. Condividi il risultato e costruisci una striscia.
- Classica — scegli la difficoltà e batti il tuo record.
- Sopravvivenza — un errore e finisce lì.
- Hot Streak — sessanta secondi, più domande possibile.
- Multigiocatore online — sfida gli amici in tempo reale con un codice stanza.
- Passa e gioca — multigiocatore locale su un solo dispositivo.

FATTO DIVERSAMENTE
- Scritto a mano e controllato sui libri dei record
- La maggior parte delle risposte ha una breve spiegazione
- Funziona offline; i tuoi risultati si sincronizzano quando torni online
- Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciante pubblicitario e i tuoi dati non vengono mai venduti

Fatto da solo dalla Norvegia da qualcuno che ama questo sport.

Hai trovato un errore? Scrivi a hello@balliq.app. Ogni messaggio arriva direttamente allo sviluppatore.
it.whatsNew:
Giocatore Misterioso e Percorso Trasferimenti fanno ora parte delle tue quattro sfide quotidiane.

• Inizia a scrivere un nome in entrambi i giochi e scegli dalla lista ordinata. Non serve più scrivere il nome alla perfezione per tentare.
• Classifica molto più precisa in Giocatore Misterioso. Ora conta anche l'epoca, così un portiere della stessa generazione risulta vicino quanto dovrebbe.
• Migliaia di giocatori risultavano in una squadra che avevano già lasciato. Ora le squadre attuali sono corrette.
• Corretto un problema che poteva bloccare l'app sulla schermata di caricamento senza connessione.

id.description:
Ball IQ — Kuis Sepak Bola

Kuis sepak bola untuk orang yang benar-benar menonton sepak bola.

Setiap pertanyaan ditulis dan diperiksa oleh penggemar — tidak pernah disalin, tidak pernah dibuat otomatis. Dari Liga Inggris sampai Eredivisie, Ball IQ punya kedalaman yang dituntut pendukung sejati.

Empat teka-teki harian, kuis untuk klubmu sendiri, dan satu tempat untuk tahu seberapa banyak yang benar-benar kamu kuasai.

FOOTLE — TEKA-TEKI KATA HARIAN
Nama belakang seorang pemain, enam tebakan, dan petunjuk warna huruf demi huruf: hijau untuk huruf yang tepat di posisi tepat, oranye untuk huruf yang tepat di posisi salah. Semua orang mendapat pemain yang sama setiap hari.

JEJAK TRANSFER — KENALI DARI KARIERNYA
Karier seorang pemain muncul klub demi klub: tim junior, klub yang membesarkan namanya, transfer besar. Makin sedikit klub yang kamu butuhkan, makin besar poinmu.

PEMAIN MISTERI — SETIAP TEBAKAN MENDEKATKANMU
Sebutkan pemain mana pun dan dia kembali dengan peringkat terhadap pemain rahasia: klub yang sama, era, posisi, kebangsaan, dan usia semuanya dihitung. Peringkat satu adalah jawabannya, dan hanya itu.

KUIS UNTUK KLUBMU
Bukan ronde umum: kuis khusus dan terverifikasi untuk klub yang benar-benar kamu dukung — Manchester United, Liverpool, Arsenal, Chelsea, Real Madrid, Barcelona, Juventus, Milan, Bayern, PSG, Ajax, dan banyak lagi.

MODE PERMAINAN
- Daily 7 — kuis baru setiap hari. Bagikan skormu dan bangun rentetan.
- Klasik — pilih tingkat kesulitan dan kalahkan rekormu.
- Bertahan — satu jawaban salah dan selesai.
- Hot Streak — enam puluh detik, sebanyak mungkin pertanyaan.
- Multipemain online — tantang teman secara langsung lewat kode ruang.
- Main bergantian — multipemain lokal di satu perangkat.

DIBUAT BERBEDA
- Ditulis tangan dan dicocokkan dengan buku rekor
- Sebagian besar jawaban disertai penjelasan singkat
- Bisa dimainkan offline; skormu tersinkron saat kembali online
- Tanpa iklan, tanpa pelacak iklan pihak ketiga, dan datamu tidak pernah dijual

Dibuat sendirian dari Norwegia oleh orang yang mencintai olahraga ini.

Menemukan kesalahan? Kirim email ke hello@balliq.app. Setiap pesan langsung sampai ke pengembang.
id.whatsNew:
Pemain Misteri dan Jejak Transfer kini bagian dari empat teka-teki harianmu.

• Mulai ketik sebuah nama di kedua permainan dan pilih dari daftar berperingkat. Tidak perlu lagi mengeja nama dengan sempurna untuk menebak.
• Peringkat Pemain Misteri jauh lebih tajam. Era kini ikut dihitung, jadi kiper dari generasi yang sama terbaca sedekat seharusnya.
• Ribuan pemain terdaftar dengan klub yang sudah mereka tinggalkan. Klub mereka sekarang sudah benar.
• Memperbaiki bug yang bisa membuat aplikasi tertahan di layar pemuatan saat tidak ada koneksi.

ar.name: Ball IQ - كويز كرة القدم
ar.subtitle: خمّن اللاعب كل يوم
ar.promo: جديد: اللاعب الغامض ومسار الانتقالات. أربعة تحديات يومية. خمّن اللاعب السري، واعرفه من مسيرته، وحافظ على سلسلتك.
ar.description:
Ball IQ — كويز كرة القدم

اختبار كرة القدم لمن يتابع كرة القدم فعلاً.

كل سؤال هنا يكتبه ويتحقق منه مشجعون — لا يُنسخ أبداً ولا يُولَّد آلياً. من الدوري الإنجليزي إلى الدوري الهولندي، ومن دوري الأبطال إلى مباراة الأمس، يقدم Ball IQ العمق الذي يطلبه المشجع الحقيقي.

أربعة تحديات يومية، واختبار خاص بناديك، ومكان واحد تكتشف فيه كم تعرف حقاً.

فوتل — تحدي الكلمات اليومي
اسم لاعب واحد، ست محاولات، وتلميحات ملونة حرفاً بحرف: الأخضر للحرف الصحيح في مكانه الصحيح، والبرتقالي للحرف الصحيح في مكان خاطئ. الجميع يحصل على اللاعب نفسه كل يوم.

مسار الانتقالات — اعرفه من مسيرته
تظهر مسيرة اللاعب نادياً بعد نادٍ: فريق الناشئين، ثم نادي الانطلاقة، ثم الانتقال الكبير. كلما احتجت أندية أقل، حصلت على نقاط أكثر.

اللاعب الغامض — كل تخمين يقرّبك
اذكر أي لاعب وسيعود مرتّباً مقابل اللاعب السري: الأندية المشتركة والحقبة والمركز والجنسية والعمر، كلها تُحتسب. المركز الأول هو الإجابة ولا شيء غيره.

اختبار لناديك
ليست جولة عامة، بل اختبار مخصص ومُدقّق للنادي الذي تشجعه فعلاً — ريال مدريد وبرشلونة وليفربول ومانشستر يونايتد ويوفنتوس وميلان وبايرن وباريس سان جيرمان وأياكس وغيرها الكثير.

أنماط اللعب
- Daily 7 — اختبار جديد كل يوم. شارك نتيجتك وابنِ سلسلتك.
- الكلاسيكي — اختر مستوى الصعوبة وتجاوز أفضل نتيجة لك.
- البقاء — إجابة خاطئة واحدة وينتهي كل شيء.
- Hot Streak — ستون ثانية وأكبر عدد ممكن من الأسئلة.
- اللعب الجماعي عبر الإنترنت — تحدَّ أصدقاءك مباشرة عبر رمز غرفة.
- التمرير واللعب — لعب جماعي محلي على جهاز واحد.

صُنع بطريقة مختلفة
- مكتوب يدوياً ومراجَع على سجلات الأرقام القياسية
- معظم الإجابات مصحوبة بشرح قصير
- يعمل دون اتصال، وتتزامن نتائجك عند عودتك للإنترنت
- بلا إعلانات، وبلا أدوات تتبع إعلانية خارجية، ولا تُباع بياناتك أبداً

طوّره شخص واحد من النرويج يعشق هذه اللعبة.

وجدت خطأ؟ راسلنا على hello@balliq.app. كل رسالة تصل مباشرة إلى المطوّر.
ar.whatsNew:
اللاعب الغامض ومسار الانتقالات صارا جزءاً من تحدياتك اليومية الأربعة.

• ابدأ بكتابة اسم في أي من اللعبتين واختره من قائمة مرتبة. لم تعد بحاجة إلى كتابة الاسم بشكل صحيح تماماً لتخمّن.
• ترتيب أدق بكثير في اللاعب الغامض. الحقبة تُحتسب الآن، فيظهر حارس من جيل الإجابة نفسه قريباً كما ينبغي.
• آلاف اللاعبين كانوا مدرجين مع نادٍ سبق أن غادروه. أنديتهم الحالية صحيحة الآن.
• إصلاح خلل كان قد يُبقي التطبيق عالقاً على شاشة التحميل دون اتصال.
